Collect parameters into a schema

Source: R/core-registry-schema.R
hr_schema.Rd

Collect parameters into a schema

Usage

hr_schema(...)

Arguments

...

hr_param() objects. Their order is the order hr_validate() resolves them in, so a bound that depends on another parameter comes after it.

Value

An object of class hr_schema: a list of hr_param, named by parameter.

See also

hr_param(), hr_validate()

Examples

s <- hr_schema(
  hr_param("max_tokens", "integer", default = 1200L, min = 32, max = 1e6),
  hr_param("overlap_tokens", "integer", default = 0L, min = 0,
           max = function(p) p$max_tokens - 1L))
suppressWarnings(hr_validate(s, list(max_tokens = 100, overlap_tokens = 500)))
#> $max_tokens
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $overlap_tokens
#> [1] 99
#>
